Genesis Intel Hub — Privacy

Genesis Intel Hub is an independent public-source research website. We collect limited first-party usage analytics to understand readership, improve site navigation and identify broad research interests.

When enabled, our analytics record a temporary per-tab random session identifier, approximate country/region/city, network ASN/operator supplied by Cloudflare, browser and operating-system family, device category, referring website hostname, visited site sections and interactions such as article/project opens and searches. We record search result counts, not search text. For site audience analysis, we also record the IP address that Cloudflare supplies for a visit, to help identify broad network patterns and potential organizational interest; IP addresses do not establish individual identity or employer. We do not intentionally collect visitor names, email addresses, full user-agent strings, search terms or fingerprinting identifiers in our analytics database. Cloudflare may process request information independently to provide hosting and security.

Network operators and approximate locations are not reliable evidence of an individual's identity, employer or exact location. Our first-party session ID is stored in sessionStorage, not in a tracking cookie, and may persist until the browser tab or session closes. Raw IP observation records are retained for up to 30 days after their last observed use and automatically purged; event and session records are retained for up to 90 days, subject to scheduled cleanup. Raw IP addresses and other analytics reports are restricted to authorized administrators through Cloudflare Access. IP addresses can be shared or rotated by residential, mobile, institutional, proxy or VPN networks; neither network affiliation nor approximate location is proof of a visitor's identity or employer.

We do not sell visitor analytics data. Questions or privacy requests may be directed to the site operator using contact details provided through the site's official communication channels.
